description:
## What

The "one-shot PeriodicCleanup.register_cleanup with lazy cleanup_proc" pattern is duplicated in 4 files:

- `src/fetcher/dns_cache.cr` (ensure_cleanup_registered, class-level)
- `src/fetcher/cache_store.cr` (register_cleanup_once, instance-level, with unregister)
- `src/fetcher/circuit_breaker_store.cr` (register_cleanup_once, instance-level)
- `src/fetcher/rate_limiter_store.cr` (register_cleanup_once, instance-level)

Each declares `@cleanup_proc : Proc(Nil)?`, `@cleanup_registered : Bool`, a lazy `cleanup_proc` getter, and a `register_cleanup_once` (or `ensure_cleanup_registered`) method that does read-then-write on the flag.

## Why

DRY violation. The pattern is identical; only the callback target differs. The `dns_cache.cr` self-locking fix (fetcherc-zu4) had to be applied 4 times. Adding a new periodic-cleanup-using store means repeating the pattern.

Functional/purity angle: the lazy `@cleanup_proc ||= ...` initializer and the read-then-write on the flag are both imperative patterns. A cleaner design would have a single "register one cleanup proc" primitive.

## How

Extract a mixin or helper class:

```crystal
module PeriodicCleanupRegistration
  @cleanup_proc : Proc(Nil)? = nil
  @cleanup_registered : Bool = false

  def register_cleanup_once(&block : -> Nil)
    @cleanup_registered = true
    PeriodicCleanup.register_cleanup { block.call }
  end
end
```

Stores that want periodic cleanup `include PeriodicCleanupRegistration` and call `register_cleanup_once { cleanup }` once during init. The mixin owns the flag and the lazy proc.

The dns_cache case (class-level) is slightly different (no instance state). For that, a separate module or a class-level variant.

## Counter-considerations

The dns_cache version (class-level) and the store versions (instance-level) have different shapes. May need two helpers or a design that bridges both.

## Done when

- All 4 sites use the shared helper
- No more hand-rolled cleanup_proc / cleanup_registered pairs (in the new code; dns_cache's existing pair is one-shot)
- Full spec suite still green
title: Refactor: deduplicate one-shot PeriodicCleanup registration (4 places)
